title: Dictation: a playground and a better process

message.text: Your words so far are above. They stop mid-thought at the Whisper results. Keep dictating here or in the sidebar; I launch the playground task once you finish. So far it covers: a playground on the default dictation page; a new session in one click that starts transcribing; an audio source panel showing which mic is used and its live level; and the structure of each Whisper result.

Taken: I'm building the playground at the top of the Dictate page, with a mic panel, the raw Whisper lines, and the Raw · Corrections · Live tabs. Two Sonnet builders in worktree qf-3: one adds a fast cleanup call to Servex, the other builds the playground; the structured final version waits for the structured-content card.

Two builders are working now: one adds the fast-assistant cleanup call, the other builds the playground with a ▶ Sample button so it can be tried without a microphone. The cleanup call needs one Servex restart to go live; until then the playground shows a simple rules-only cleanup, labelled as such.

The cleanup call works: "what do you think? about the the layout" came back as "What do you think about the layout?" in about 2.5 seconds. Fillers and doubled words go, and nothing else is reworded; the playground builder is still working.

First playground build works: ▶ Sample runs the raw Whisper lines, the red/green corrections, and the live fade. I sent it back for six fixes, the main one being that your default Dictate page must carry the whole playground, not just the mic toolbar.

The playground now sits at the top of your Dictate page: mic, audio source with a level meter, and Raw · Corrections · Live tabs, where Live fades the red/green marks into clean text. A fresh reviewer is checking it now; then I merge and restart Servex so the fast assistant's cleanup goes live.

The playground is merged and live at /framework/ux/Dictate/ — every Dictate page loads with no errors. A Next/Next walkthrough with the fast assistant's real corrections is being made now; after that I restart Servex so the cleanup runs for you live.

Landed: the playground is at the top of /framework/ux/Dictate/, and /framework/ux/Dictate/playground/walkthrough/ shows it step by step with the fast assistant's real corrections. The files are merged but not committed, because your working tree already held someone else's unfinished Dictate edits; I'm restarting Servex now so the cleanup runs live for you.
